narrative.overview: The whole app is the Singapore Government Design System (SGDS v3), used as shipped. Nothing is restyled: colour, type, spacing and radius all arrive from SGDS theme tokens and its sgds: Tailwind v4 utilities. The app's own stylesheet adds only base resets and two font-family overrides, so the look of a new screen is decided by which SGDS component and which SGDS utility is chosen, not by new CSS.
keyCharacteristics: SGDS web components for every control, container and overlay; no hand-built look-alikes.
White surfaces on a gray alternate ground; borders and flatness do the layering.
Purple is for action and "you are here"; green, yellow, blue and gray badges carry verification state.
Type and spacing from sgds: utilities only; Inter for text, Roboto Mono for code and ids.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: Colour is named by SGDS token or sgds: utility. A raw hex in a component is a defect.

rules.name: The Verification Colour Rule
rules.body: Green, yellow and blue mean verification state and nothing else; purple never marks state.

rules.name: The Real Utility Rule
rules.body: Only SGDS utilities that exist work (text-heading-lg/sm, text-subtitle-md, text-body-*, text-caption-md, font-regular, font-semibold, font-code, gap-2-xs, z-10). z-raised, text-heading-xs, font-mono and text-body-xs are not real.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: Panels are bg-surface-default, border-muted, rounded-surface, no shadow. Only a sticky bar over scrolling content may carry the edge shadow.

dos: Do reach for the SGDS component first and check node_modules/@govtechsg/sgds-web-component before building anything custom.
Do take type and spacing only from sgds: utilities; headings, paragraphs and lists have zero margin, so spacing comes from gap-* on the parent.
Do use sgds:font-code for code and ids and sgds:text-subtle for secondary copy.
Do pass select options as menuList data and keep control accessible names stable.
Do map verification state to badge variants exactly as in app/plan/badge.tsx.
donts: Don't use z-raised, text-heading-xs, font-mono or text-body-xs; they do not exist (use z-10, text-subtitle-md, font-code, text-caption-md).
Don't add raw hex colours, pixel spacing, custom shadows or new fonts, or put component styling in globals.css.
Don't use purple for state, or green/yellow/blue for decoration.
Don't add a government masthead or GovTech/agency logos; this is a local prototype.
Don't restyle away SGDS focus rings or contrast.
